entries.title: A crewmate can post a reply you already allowed, with no card
entries.body: When a task that replies on your project, such as a comment on an issue, would wait for your click, it now posts the reply once with no card if a yes of yours still covers it: a direction you gave for that project, a yes on one of the task's cards, or words you gave for the task. The task's Activity quotes the words it rested on. A crewmate that reads words anyone can write, a change to another project and an integration's actions still ask you. The new guide An intake round shows how to answer new issues this way on a schedule.
entries.noPicture: The change skips an approval card rather than adding a new screen; its one new line sits in a task's existing Activity.
